description: This file defines the RetryMiddleware class for the GuzzleHttp HTTP client library. It implements middleware that retries HTTP requests based on custom decider logic, supporting exponential backoff delay strategies.

classes.name: RetryMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that manages retrying HTTP requests based on user-defined logic, including customizable delay strategies.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the middleware with a decider, a next handler, and an optional delay function.

methods.name: exponentialDelay
methods.description: Static method providing a default exponential backoff delay calculation based on the number of retries.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware, passing the request through the next handler and attaching fulfillment and rejection handlers.

methods.name: onFulfilled
methods.description: Returns a callback that handles successful responses, deciding whether to retry based on decider logic.

methods.name: onRejected
methods.description: Returns a callback that handles failed responses, deciding whether to retry based on decider logic.

methods.name: doRetry
methods.description: Performs a retry by updating the delay and invoking the request again.
